episode_title: Brave Business Triumphs S6:E7: AI Readiness Miniseries (e4) with Jamie Jurgaitis

real_qa.q: Why does AI as a force multiplier create risk if a business has unclear workflows or weak data?
real_qa.r: AI does not enter a perfect business—it enters the business as it is. Whatever is already moving through that system, good or bad, may start moving faster. If the business is clear, AI can multiply clarity; if confused, AI can multiply confusion. If data is trusted, AI multiplies intelligence; if weak, it multiplies false confidence.
real_qa.requete: AI force multiplier risks unclear workflows weak data

real_qa.q: What are the main concerns when AI is repeatedly applied across organizational decisions and workflows?
real_qa.r: When AI starts showing up repeatedly in decisions, workflows, customer interactions, employee behavior, content analysis and reporting, that changes the level and dynamics of AI in an organization because it starts changing the stakes involved. Leaders need to know whether AI is multiplying something strong enough to scale.
real_qa.requete: AI repeated workflows organizational decisions stakes

real_qa.q: How can leaders reduce employee anxiety about AI implementation while building confidence?
real_qa.r: Leaders need to explain and be honest about intent without sugarcoating it. If people understand the intent from the start, understand the guardrails and expected value, AI can multiply confidence and capability. But if people feel unclear and pressured, AI can multiply anxiety very quickly, leading to avoidance or sabotage of pilot programs.
real_qa.requete: reduce employee anxiety AI confidence leadership intent

real_qa.q: What role does data sensitivity and training data governance play in employee trust of AI systems?
real_qa.r: Companies need to be clear on what data they want to train AI on and what they do not want to train. There are concerns about large companies using employee data to train AI systems, which creates distrust. Employees do not want to support or hear about their data being used to train AI that could eliminate their jobs.
real_qa.requete: AI training data employee data sensitivity trust

real_qa.q: How does weak brand guidance or unclear escalation paths affect customer experience with AI-powered support?
real_qa.r: If brand guidance is weak, tools create generic content that is not authentic to the brand. If escalation paths are unclear and automated, customers get frustrated because they feel like they are just part of a funnel rather than receiving genuine support. This affects how authentically the AI system interacts with and portrays the customer experience.
real_qa.requete: AI customer support brand guidance escalation paths
